```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(leaflet)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)

options(tidyverse.quiet = TRUE)

source("pir_source.R")
source("disability_source.R")
hs_palette <- c("#e51937","#0063a6","#fff13b","#499f68","#84dcc6","#693668","#373d20","#717744")
```

## Disability in MA in 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of infants and children 0-5 served under IDEA in MA"

ma_disabled_total_2024 <- disability_under_5 |>
  filter(ST == "MA" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(IDEA_DISABLED_0_5) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_disabled_total_2024
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of the infants and children 0-5 served under IDEA in MA"

ma_disabled_percent_2024 <- disability_under_5 |>
  filter(ST == "MA" & YEAR_END == 2024) |>
  select(STATEWIDE_PROP_DISABLED) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(ma_disabled_percent_2024, 2)
)
```

## Temporal Visualizations

```{r}
#| fill: false

options(scipen = 999)
disability_under_5 |>
  filter(YEAR_END <= 2024) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(ST == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           ST != "MA" ~ "Other States")) |>
  group_by(YEAR_END, is_ma) |>
  filter(!is.na(is_ma)) |>
  summarize(disabled_children = sum(IDEA_DISABLED_0_5, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_population = sum(POPULATION_UNDER_5, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(YEAR_END) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         disabled_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ disabled_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(disabled_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_population = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_population,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_population, na.rm = TRUE)),
         percent_disabled = disabled_children / total_population * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR_END, y = percent_disabled, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "% Children 0-5 Receiving IDEA Services",
       col = "",
       title = "Children 0-5 Receiving IDEA Services, 2021 - 2024") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_disabled, 2)),
            vjust = -0.25)

```

```{r}
#| fill: false

combined_pir |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(State == "MA" ~ "MA",

            total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE)) |>

  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(is_ma = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ "MA",
                           is_ma != "MA" ~ "USA"),
         disabled_children = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ disabled_children,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(disabled_children, na.rm = TRUE)),
         total_child_enroll = case_when(is_ma == "MA" ~ total_child_enroll,
                           is_ma == "USA" ~ sum(total_child_enroll, na.rm = TRUE)),
         percent_disabled = disabled_children / total_child_enroll * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_disabled, col = is_ma, group = is_ma)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "% Enrolled Children Receiving IDEA Services",
       col = "",
       title = paste("Head Start IDEA Enrollments, ",
                     min(combined_pir$pir_year),
                     "-" ,
                     max(combined_pir$pir_year))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(percent_disabled, 2)),
            vjust = -0.25)

```


## Rankings


```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "How MA ranks against other states in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start receiving IDEA services"
#| fill: false

disablity_state_rank <- combined_pir |>
  group_by(pir_year, State) |>
  summarize(disabled_children = sum(C.24, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(C.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_child_enroll = sum(A.10.g, na.rm = TRUE),
      percent_disabled = round(disabled_children / total_child_enroll * 100, 2)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  mutate(state_rank = rank(-percent_disabled, ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup()

ma_ranking <- disablity_state_rank |>
  filter(State == "MA" & pir_year == 2024) |>
  select(state_rank) |>
  pull()

list(
  icon = "award",
  color = "info",
  value = ma_ranking
)
```


```{r}
#| fill: false
#| title: "Top 5 States + MA in terms of percent of children enrolled in Head Start that are receiving IDEA services"
disablity_state_rank |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024 & (State == "MA" | state_rank <= 5)) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_disabled)) |>
  select(State, 
         `% receiving disablity services` = percent_disabled ) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| fill: false

us_states <- states(cb = TRUE, 
                    resolution = "20m", 
                    progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  left_join(disablity_state_rank |>
              filter(pir_year == 2024), by = c("STUSPS" = "State")) |>
  st_transform(4326)

labels <- paste("<strong>", 
                us_states$NAME,
                "</strong><br>Rank:", 
                us_states$state_rank,
                "<br>% receiving disablity services:",
                us_states$percent_disabled) |>
  lapply(htmltools::HTML)

pal_bin_state_rank <- colorBin(palette="BuGn", 
                    domain = us_states$percent_disabled,
                    bins = 4)

disability_hs_map <- leaflet(width = "100%") %>%
  setView(lat = 30, lng = -95, zoom = 3) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap) |> 
  addPolygons(data = us_states, 
              weight = 1,
              color = "black",
              fillColor = ~pal_bin_state_rank(percent_disabled),
              fillOpacity = 0.8, 
              label = labels) |>
  addLegend(data = us_states,
            title = "% Receiving IDEA Services", 
            pal = pal_bin_state_rank, 
            values = ~percent_disabled)

disability_hs_map
```
